# ankra_cloud_dns_zone_access (Resource)

The access gateway policy of an Ankra Cloud DNS zone (`ankra org access-gateway set`): who may reach the hostnames the Ankra Cloud proxy serves in the zone. `public` lets anyone through; `organisation` admits only signed-in members of the organisation, optionally only those holding one of `roles` and only those who can reach `project_id`. A zone without a policy of its own inherits its parent zone's.

Needs the `members.manage` permission. Destroy removes the resource from state and leaves the zone's policy in force, so a destroy never opens a gated zone to the public.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_cloud_dns_zones" "all" {}

locals {
  apps_zone = one([for zone in data.ankra_cloud_dns_zones.all.zones : zone if zone.name == "apps.acme.ankra.app"])
}

# Only admins and operators who can reach the platform project may open
# hostnames in the zone.
resource "ankra_cloud_dns_zone_access" "apps" {
  zone_id    = local.apps_zone.id
  mode       = "organisation"
  roles      = ["admin", "operator"]
  project_id = "platform"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `mode` (String) `public` (anyone) or `organisation` (signed-in members of the organisation only).
- `zone_id` (String) Identifier of the zone, from `ankra_cloud_dns_zones`. Changing it replaces the resource.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Admit only the members who can reach this project, by ID or slug; unset removes the limit. Only with `mode = "organisation"`. Writing the same project as its slug or its ID plans no change.
- `roles` (Set of String) Organisation roles admitted, by slug; unset admits every member. Only with `mode = "organisation"`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The zone id.
- `inherited_from` (String) The zone the effective policy is inherited from, when the zone has no policy of its own (for example after it was removed outside Terraform); null while the zone's own policy applies.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by zone id.
terraform import ankra_cloud_dns_zone_access.apps 7f3c2a10-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
```
